logo.modifications: Whale path extracted without the wordmark; white fill and desktop icon placement.

artwork.badge: System heavy text converted to SVG outlines inside the layered document; the capsule, placement and effects are the composition the Windows icon is rendered from.

windowsPackaging: The layered Icon Composer document stays the source of record. macOS renders build/app-icon.png from it, and the committed PNG is reused on every host: dsh-desktop-next/scripts/generate-windows-app-icon.mjs derives the exact-DPI app-icon.ico that electron-builder and NSIS embed. icons:check verifies the layered source digest and both committed exports without Xcode.
